### ReConPlot

```{r reconplot-info}
# SECTION_DATA[["reconplot"]] (R/sections/reconplot.R): genome-wide, per-chromosome and focus PNGs per SV/CN combination
reconplot = SECTION_DATA[["reconplot"]]
if (is.null(reconplot)) {
  section_notice("No ReConPlot figures found for this sample.")
}
```

```{r reconplot-figures, results='asis'}
# Raw HTML blocks inside markdown (tabset/callout fences), so Pandoc leaves the base64 alone
if (!is.null(reconplot)) {
  raw_html = function(tag) cat("\n```{=html}\n", as.character(tag), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")

  rp_rel = function(p) sample_rel_path(p, sample_dir)
  plural = function(n, one, many = paste0(one, "s")) paste(n, if (n == 1) one else many)

  full_embed = identical(as.character(embed)[1], "full")
  # Slim mode: per-chromosome figures of chromosomes with a high-impact call only, and no
  # genome-wide figure (reconplot_chromosomes() in R/sections/reconplot.R says which and why)
  sel = reconplot_chromosomes(OVERVIEW$findings, SECTION_DATA$sv$table,
                              SECTION_DATA$shatterseek$high)
  # Size cap: the best-ranked RECONPLOT_MAX_CHROMS chromosomes; the footnote names the rest
  capped = reconplot_cap(sel, RECONPLOT_MAX_CHROMS, chromosomes)
  sel = capped$kept

  combos = reconplot$combos
  label = function(cb) if (cb %in% names(RECONPLOT_COMBO_LABELS)) RECONPLOT_COMBO_LABELS[[cb]] else cb

  # The user's own regions/genes (pipeline focus/ figures) open the section, always embedded
  focus_combos = names(combos)[vapply(combos, function(x) length(x$focus) > 0, logical(1))]
  has_focus = length(focus_combos) > 0
  if (has_focus) {
    cat("#### Your regions\n\n")
    cat('<p class="report-figure__caption">The regions and genes requested for ReConPlot',
        '(<code>--reconplot_regions</code>, <code>--reconplot_genes</code>), one figure per SV caller /',
        'copy-number source.</p>\n\n')
    if (length(focus_combos) > 1) cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
    for (cb in focus_combos) {
      if (length(focus_combos) > 1) cat("##### ", label(cb), "\n\n", sep = "")
      fx = combos[[cb]]$focus
      raw_html(tags$div(class = "rp-grid rp-grid--focus", lapply(names(fx), function(r)
        embed_png(fx[[r]], max_width = "100%", caption = paste0(label(cb), ": ", r)))))
    }
    if (length(focus_combos) > 1) cat(":::\n\n")
  }

  chrom_combos = names(combos)[vapply(combos, function(x) length(x$chroms) > 0 || !is.null(x$genome), logical(1))]
  if (length(chrom_combos) > 0) {
    if (has_focus)
      cat('::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Chromosomes with a call (automatic selection)"}\n\n')

    cat('<p class="report-figure__caption">Copy number (total and minor allele) with SV arcs',
        'coloured by type, from ReConPlot; one figure set per SV caller / copy-number source.',
        if (!full_embed) paste(
          'Shown: the chromosomes with a high-impact call, that is a ShatterSeek chromothripsis',
          'call or an SV Padfoot gave a cancer-gene rating (HIGH_ONCO, HIGH_TSG; always), or a tier 1–2',
          'SV or copy-number key finding',
          'of the ticked gene list(s).'),
        '</p>\n\n')

    # Which reasons select a figure: one tickbox per reason kind present
    rp_kinds = unique(unlist(strsplit(sel$kinds, ",", fixed = TRUE)))
    rp_kind_label = c(chromothripsis = "Chromothripsis call (at the ShatterSeek tier selected above)",
                      padfoot = "Padfoot cancer-gene rating (HIGH_ONCO, HIGH_TSG)",
                      finding = "Tier 1–2 SV or copy-number key finding of the ticked gene list(s)")
    rp_kinds = intersect(names(rp_kind_label), rp_kinds)
    if (!full_embed && length(rp_kinds) > 1)
      raw_html(tags$div(class = "rp-reasons", tags$span(class = "rp-reasons__label", "Show figures for:"),
        lapply(rp_kinds, function(k) tags$label(class = "rp-reasons__item",
          tags$input(type = "checkbox", class = "rp-reason", value = k, checked = NA), " ", rp_kind_label[[k]]))))

    if (length(chrom_combos) > 1) cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
    for (cb in chrom_combos) {
      x = combos[[cb]]
      if (length(chrom_combos) > 1) cat("#### ", label(cb), "\n\n", sep = "")
      chroms = x$chroms
      # reconplot/<combo>/, which holds genome_wide/ and per_chromosome/
      any_fig = if (length(chroms) > 0) chroms[[1]] else x$genome
      folder = rp_rel(dirname(dirname(any_fig)))

      if (full_embed) {
        if (!is.null(x$genome))
          raw_html(embed_png(x$genome, max_width = "100%",
                             caption = paste0(label(cb), ": genome-wide")))
        if (length(chroms) > 0)
          raw_html(tags$div(class = "rp-grid", lapply(names(chroms), function(ch)
            embed_png(chroms[[ch]], max_width = "100%", caption = paste0(label(cb), ": ", ch)))))
        next
      }

      show = names(chroms)[names(chroms) %in% sel$chrom]
      if (length(show) == 0) {
        raw_html(section_notice(if (length(chroms) == 0)
          "No per-chromosome ReConPlot figure for this combination."
          else "No chromosome has a chromothripsis call, an SV with a Padfoot cancer-gene rating (HIGH_ONCO, HIGH_TSG) or a tier 1–2 SV or copy-number key finding in any gene list."))
      } else {
        s = sel[match(show, chrom)]
        figs = lapply(seq_along(show), function(i) {
          tags$div(class = "rp-fig",
                   `data-always` = if (s$always[i]) "1" else "0",
                   `data-kinds` = s$kinds[i],
                   `data-ss-tier` = if (!is.na(s$ss_tier[i])) s$ss_tier[i],
                   `data-panels` = s$panels[i], `data-genes` = s$genes[i],
                   hidden = if (!s$always[i]) NA,
                   embed_png(chroms[[show[i]]], max_width = "100%",
                             caption = paste0(show[i], ": ", s$reasons[i])))
        })
        raw_html(tags$div(class = "rp-grid", figs,
          tags$p(class = "rp-none table-footnote", hidden = if (any(s$always)) NA,
                 "No figure matches the selected reasons, ShatterSeek tier and gene list(s); tick a list or a reason to show its chromosomes.")))
      }
      rest = length(chroms) - length(show)
      over = intersect(capped$dropped$chrom, names(chroms))
      omitted = c(if (!is.null(x$genome)) "the genome-wide figure",
                  if (rest > 0) paste0(plural(rest, "other per-chromosome figure"),
                    if (length(over)) sprintf(" (%s of them with a call, beyond the %d embedded: %s)",
                                              length(over), RECONPLOT_MAX_CHROMS, paste(over, collapse = ", ")) else ""))
      if (length(omitted) > 0) {
        # One HTML string: htmltools' newlines between children would render as " ."
        raw_html(tags$p(class = "table-footnote", HTML(sprintf(
          "Not embedded: %s; see <code>%s</code>. Render with <code>--embed full</code> to include every figure.",
          paste(omitted, collapse = " and "), htmltools::htmlEscape(folder)))))
      }
    }
    if (length(chrom_combos) > 1) cat(":::\n\n")
    if (has_focus) cat(":::\n\n")
  }

  # Figures follow the reason tickboxes, the ShatterSeek tier selector (window.ssMinTier, "ss-tier"
  # event, _instability.qmd) and the gene-list chips through the overview's own predicate
  # (window.keyFindings.kfRowMatches, looked up per call: key_findings.js is inlined later)
  if (!full_embed && nrow(sel) > 0) raw_html(tags$script(HTML('
(function () {
  var last = null;
  function apply(s) {
    if (s) last = s;
    var kf = window.keyFindings, on = {};
    document.querySelectorAll(".rp-reason").forEach(function (cb) { on[cb.value] = cb.checked; });
    var minTier = Number(window.ssMinTier || 3);
    document.querySelectorAll(".rp-grid").forEach(function (grid) {
      var shown = 0;
      grid.querySelectorAll(".rp-fig").forEach(function (fig) {
        var kinds = (fig.getAttribute("data-kinds") || "").split(",");
        var has = function (k) { return kinds.indexOf(k) >= 0 && on[k] !== false; };
        var t = fig.getAttribute("data-ss-tier");
        var show = has("chromothripsis") && (t ? Number(t) <= minTier : minTier >= 3);
        if (!show) show = has("padfoot");
        if (!show && has("finding") && kf && last) {
          var genes = (fig.getAttribute("data-genes") || "").split(",");
          show = kf.kfRowMatches({ gene: genes[0] || "", genes: genes, tier: 1,
                                   panels: (fig.getAttribute("data-panels") || "").split(",") }, last);
        }
        fig.hidden = !show;
        if (show) shown++;
      });
      var none = grid.querySelector(".rp-none");
      if (none) none.hidden = shown > 0;
    });
  }
  document.querySelectorAll(".rp-reason").forEach(function (cb) {
    cb.addEventListener("change", function () { apply(); });
  });
  document.addEventListener("ss-tier", function () { apply(); });
  if (typeof window.registerPanelListener === "function")
    window.registerPanelListener(function (s) { apply(s); });
  else apply();
})();')))
}
```
